column1: Each cell is a product's weighted coverage of that category, read live from the Tier 2 scorecard (0 = untouched). Set a product to TRUE in the selector row to include it in the combination; 'Combined (selected)' shows the best coverage any selected product reaches, and 'Gap?' flags categories the selected combination still leaves uncovered. This answers whether a few products together can fill our needs.
